entry.title: Liga Privada 10 Selección de Mercado Coronets — Tin of 10
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, cola, dark rum or bourbon (projected)
Occasion: Quick premium smoke, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Black pepper, Italian espresso, cedar, toasted earth and restrained sweetness define Selección de Mercado's international-market interpretation of Liga Privada 10. Its reddish Connecticut Criollo wrapper sits over Mexican San Andrés and Nicaraguan/Pennsylvania filler, producing a pepper-forward, coffee-heavy profile distinct from both H99 and the darker Broadleaf Liga blends. The 4″ × 32 Coronet compresses that profile into a genuinely compact premium smoke. Untasted here, so Strength 7 and Quality 8 remain projections and Flavour stays unrated.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. Cigar Hut currently lists this product as ‘Undercrown Seleccion De Mercado Coronets’ from A$119, but the blend is Liga Privada 10 Selección de Mercado. The catalogue uses the correct Liga Privada identity. Flavour remains unrated until personally tasted.
practicalLines: A$11.90 per cigar at A$119 per tin
